narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On March 5, 2024, at approximately 1105 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a bus station in Lansing, Michigan, after he asked them for directions. The agents identified themselves and asked about his citizenship.
The subject stated that he is a citizen of Ecuador and that he has no documents allowing him to live or work in the United States. He showed the agents an Ecuadorian passport.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he entered the United States in or around June 2018 near El Paso, Texas.
TRAVEL:
He stated that he stayed in El Paso for two weeks and then travelled to Michigan by bus.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed and served a Notice to Appear (Form I-862).
